title: Final Risk Register
methodology: Consolidates every finding surfaced across AQ-06R1-R6, each classified BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/RECOMMENDATION per the ticket's own definitions: a BLOCKER means 'do not submit until resolved'; a HIGH finding requires a concrete reason it could materially affect review. Ordinary improvement opportunities are never classified as blockers.

conclusion: 0 blockers, 0 high-severity findings. The single high-severity finding carried from AQ-06 (AQ06-HC-01) is closed. The most significant findings this re-certification itself surfaced (AQ06R-ED-02 through 05, publication-template jargon reaching a majority of the site's pages) were remediated within this same initiative and are also closed. Every remaining open item is medium or lower, none rises to a submission blocker, and none was manufactured to pad this register — each is either a pre-existing, previously-disclosed, out-of-scope item or a narrow residual explicitly documented rather than fixed per this initiative's own regression rules.
